newsitem.title: CHINA: China ICBC loans 1.0 bln yuan to Sichuan Power.
newsitem.headline: China ICBC loans 1.0 bln yuan to Sichuan Power.

text.p: The Industrial and Commercial Bank of China (ICBC) has signed a 1.0 billion yuan ($120.48 million) loan agreement with the Sichuan Power Company, the Financial News said on Monday.

Of the amount, 800 million yuan would be used in fixed assets loans for the Ertan power station distribution project, the second phase construction of the Chengdu thermal power plant and a distribution project for the Baozhusi power project, it said.
The ICBC branch in the Sichuan provincial capital Chengdu extended 750 million yuan in loans to Sichuan Power Company last year to develop electricity output in the province, it said.
